**Finding: compliant (preferred position).**

Section 22 is the sole audit right binding Customer, and it already sits at our preferred position on every element:

| Preferred element | Where met |
|---|---|
| Once per 12 months | § 22.1 "no more than once in any twelve-month period" |
| 30 days' written notice | § 22.1 "at least thirty days' prior written notice" |
| Business hours | § 22.1 "during normal business hours" |
| Independent auditor / confidentiality-bound | § 22.1 "independent auditor bound by confidentiality" |
| Off-site where possible | § 22.1 "off-site where practicable" |
| Vendor cost unless >5% underpayment | § 22.2 |
| No direct system access | § 22.2 "may not access Customer systems directly" |

§ 22.3 adds further protection (findings are Customer Confidential Information, use limited to enforcement). No other audit, inspection, verification, records or monitoring right against Customer exists in the document (§ 23 is an empty heading). No redline proposed.
